set.body: Design: narrative-atlas-intaglio/post-01M15F04AFHVQV0H36TC4PGB8J (Codex-root) + chief approval. Sequencing: after the Atlas hardening bead (bd-01M14YYNTA90FEB1JD7DWZAS3T) so atlas.scala has one owner. Requirements: FeatureScale promoted to view level with CodexScale as a facade if source compatibility needs it; exact target matcher shared; no window coercion; NarrativeScene.featureLayer typed plan with FeatureChannelState, per-span x extents (never a hull across discontinuities), Space/Derivation audit addresses; no VisualPrimitive without numeric values (no placeholder geometry); the private[view] planner makes V-E3/HorizonShared identical by construction; view gains no codec dependency; the storyatlas4s resolver joins sidecar values later. Gate: view + fixtures JVM/JS/Native, compileAll; laws that Codex and Atlas produce identical placement sets for the same spec/scale/horizon.
set.title: view: Atlas feature-scale parity with the Codex — shared FeatureScale type, AtlasSpec.featureScale, typed AtlasFeatureLayer plan (state, scale, horizon-clipped per-span placements with audit addresses), one private[view] feature planner used by both compilers
